Override.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jie'an Jin (介菴進禪師語錄), in a later raising of the Dazhu exchange. The stored headword occurs in the question addressed to Dazhu Huihai, not in Dazhu's reply. This abbreviated witness calls the questioner 華嚴座主; the parallel passage in the Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄) names him 講華嚴志座主, Huayan Lecturer Zhi. Huayan Lecturer Zhi is therefore the exact source-attested speaker asking why Dazhu does not allow ‘luxuriant yellow flowers are none other than prajna’; Dazhu Huihai answers immediately afterward.
